description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal status of a subscription AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyAutoRenewAttribute接口设置包年包月集群自动续费状态
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-auto-renew-attribute --db-cluster-id am-bp1u389j9zjh50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The renewal status of the cluster. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: The cluster is automatically renewed.
Normal: The cluster is manually renewed.
NotRenewal: The cluster is not renewed
parameters.help_zh:
续费状态。取值：

AutoRenewal：自动续费；

Normal：手动续费；

NotRenewal：到期不续费
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The renewal duration. Default value: 1.

Valid values when PeriodUnit is set to Month: 1 to 11.
Valid values when PeriodUnit is set to Year: 1, 2, 3, and 5.

Longer subscription durations offer more savings. Purchasing a cluster for one year is more cost-effective than purchasing the cluster for 10 or 11 months
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长。默认值为1。

当PeriodUnit为Month时，取值为1~11（整数）。

当PeriodUnit为Year时，取值为1、2、3、5（整数）。
购买的时间越长价格越优惠，购买1年的实际价格会比购买10个月或11个月更划算
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the renewal duration. Default value: Month. Valid values:

Year
Month
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长单位。默认值为Month。

Year：年。

Month：月
parameters.name: period_unit
